description: 🍻 Default and OSS formulae (built-from-source packages) for the package manager for everywhere
vibe: Ship one formula, one commit, one PR — and never let the AI speak for the human.
highlights: Strict one-formula-per-PR and one-commit-per-file rule to keep diffs minimal and reviewable.
Mandatory local validation gate: build-from-source, brew test, and brew audit --strict must pass before any PR.
Tests must verify real functionality — executing the binary or compiling against the library — not just --version or --help.
Explicit AI disclosure rules with hard refusals if the user asks the AI to hide its involvement or fake human verification.
Bottle blocks are off-limits to agents; BrewTestBot owns them.
assessment: This file treats the agent as a disciplined contributor rather than a code generator, enforcing the same gates a human maintainer would face: local builds, audits, focused diffs, and honest attribution. The explicit refusal clauses around AI disclosure and maintainer communication are unusually principled, protecting the project's trust model from prompt-driven deception. It is a strong example of constraining agent velocity with process rather than cleverness.
